name: Relentless
source:
Play as a young Noblewoman in the Steam-Rococo land of Amaranth! An exciting adventure-mystery full of cross-dressing, deception, romance, and a whole lot of shenanigans. Will you determine your own life or will those above you see it through that you don't?

[From [url=https://cloudnovel.net/rambitious/novel/relentless]Cloudnovel[/url]]
translation:
在蒸汽洛可可式的苋菜王国中扮演一位年轻的贵族女性！这是一部令人兴奋的冒险悬疑剧，充满了变装、欺骗、浪漫和大量的恶作剧。你会决定自己的生活，还是那些比你高的人会看透你所看不到的生活？

[来自[url=https://cloudnovel.net/rambitious/novel/relentless]Cloudnovel[/url]]
